summary_1line: Rama annihilates Dushana and his forces in battle, then slays three demon generals and thousands more as Khara sends further armies against him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama severs both arms of the charging demon Dushana, whose golden mace falls to the battlefield as he collapses like a tuskless elephant.
Rama stands calm amid a storm of weapons, arrows flying from his bow as thousands of demons fall around him like trees struck by lightning.
The demon generals rush forward with trident, harpoon, and axe while Rama calmly draws steel-tipped arrows to meet them.
